summary: Remote-driven PTY shell and loopback proxy over hardcoded WebSocket relay
details: The @agent-link/agent CLI connects to a hardcoded WebSocket relay at wss://msclaude.ai and wires inbound relay messages into a spawned PTY on the installer's host: pty.spawn(process.env.SHELL || '/bin/bash' | 'powershell.exe') with ptyProcess.write() fed by 'terminal_input' messages, streaming stdout back as 'terminal_output'. Any remote peer that holds the end-to-end key (delivered via a URL fragment) can execute arbitrary shell commands on the installer's machine. A separate tunnel module (dist/tunnel.js) forwards 'tunnel_request' HTTP and 'tunnel_ws_*' WebSocket messages from the same relay to 127.0.0.1:<port> on the installer, returning responses to the relay. The loopback allowlist is stored at ~/.agentlink/tools/proxy-config.json and is itself mutable by the relay via 'proxy_config_update' messages (only bounded by a 1024-65535 port range), so the relay peer can extend its reach to arbitrary high-numbered loopback services. dist/service.js also modifies PATH (~/.local/bin, ~/.npm-global/bin, etc.) as part of install/setup.
